definitions.gloss: cave; cavern; hole in a rock; rocky hollow
definitions.explanation: A natural cavity or hole formed in rock. Can range from a small hollow to a sizable cave.

examples.japanese: {岩穴|いわあな}に{身|み}を{隠|かく}した。
{岩穴|いわあな}の{中|なか}は{涼|すず}しかった。
examples.english: Inside the cave it was cool.

examples.japanese: {崖|がけ}の{途中|とちゅう}に{小|ちい}さな{岩穴|いわあな}があり、{鳥|とり}が{巣|す}を{作|つく}っていた。
examples.english: There was a small rock cavity partway up the cliff, where birds had made a nest.

notes:
A straightforward compound of {岩|いわ} (rock) + {穴|あな} (hole). Has a more natural, literary feel compared to the scientific term {洞窟|どうくつ}. Often appears in folklore, mythology, and nature writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {岩穴|いわあな}に{住|す}む: to live in a cave
- {岩穴|いわあな}に{隠|かく}れる: to hide in a cave

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {洞窟|どうくつ}: cave, cavern (the standard, more formal/scientific term)
- {洞穴|どうけつ}/{洞穴|ほらあな}: cave, grotto
- {鍾乳洞|しょうにゅうどう}: limestone cave, stalactite cave
